summary: Frontend-only demo tested end-to-end via Playwright against public URL. All 8 tabs render, primary action button label/behavior updates per tab, all modals/drawers/wizards open, shared state actions (add supplier, review declaration, accept evidence, create improvement, map catalogue, impact analysis event, respond customer request, generate customer package) all work and are reflected in tables/KPIs. Deep links to /carbon-accounting/scope3 and /carbon-passports/CP-GH-2026-0001 resolve correctly with expected content, sidebar stub modules navigate. Global search filters active tab, Download menu lists 12 items (toast simulated), Audit drawer opens, Analytics toggle reveals 15 recharts charts. No console/page errors during any flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec mentions 10 recharts charts under Analytics toggle; implementation shows ~15 — minor discrepancy, likely acceptable but worth confirming intended count.
ValueChainContext.jsx is likely the single source of truth and can grow large; consider splitting actions/derived selectors into separate modules as it scales.
seed_data_creation: Added TestCo Ltd supplier during exercise (in-memory only, resets on reload)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All key data-testids verified: tab-*, primary-action-btn, add-supplier-name/submit, wiz-supplier/contact/next/send (radix Select — click trigger then role=option), dec-accept/dec-map, evd-accept/evd-reject, imp-supplier/imp-submit, cat-map-btn/map-select/map-confirm, cat-impact-btn/impact-create-event, crq-approve/crq-generate, cc-generate-package/pkg-generate, download-btn, audit-btn, toggle-analytics, global-search, supplier-row-SUP-GH-001, sc-row-*, cat-row-*, cc-row-*, dec-row-*. Wizard uses shadcn/radix Select — use click + role=option, not select_option.
